title: Correct stopping time
description: Essential: Student must recognize that the car stops before 20 seconds and calculate the actual stopping time (12.5s).

title: First distance calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute x₁ = 31.25 m using appropriate kinematics equations.

title: Second distance calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute x₂ = 0.8 m for the final 2 seconds of motion.

title: Kinematics equation selection
description: Important: Student must apply v² = u² + 2as for part (1) and s = ut + ½at² for part (2) with correct signs.

title: Deceleration sign handling
description: Important: Student must consistently treat deceleration as negative acceleration in equations.

title: Time interval understanding
description: Important: Student must recognize that part (2) asks for distance during the 2 seconds immediately before stopping, not any arbitrary 2-second interval.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout calculations.

title: Ignoring stopping time
description: Pitfall: Student assumes the car is still moving after 20 seconds and calculates distance for full 20 seconds.

title: Sign error in equations
description: Pitfall: Student uses positive acceleration instead of negative deceleration in kinematics equations.
